title: Essence: the signature view
note: One page per project and per lens that shows the chain as a picture - the idea's opening, the path, under each milestone what delivers and proves it (its workings and tools), and the work happening now (board, heartbeat, tests) - each flowing into the next. Named by the author. Needs each project's workings.
